items.title: BTCS offloads $44M in ETH to reduce DeFi debt amid market downturn
items.body: BTCS sold more than half its Ether holdings to reduce leverage following the market sell-off, while BitMine added another 7,819 ETH to its treasury.

items.title: Tom Lee Says Ethereum Is as Scarce as Bitcoin—And Bitmine Just Bought More
items.body: Chairman Tom Lee argued ETH’s supply has grown just 0.90% annually since mid-2025—roughly matching Bitcoin’s 0.82% and far below Solana, XRP and Cardano.

items.title: Ethereum wallets holding $72 billion ETH are under threat of a future quantum attack
items.body: Researchers find that accounts with visible public keys hold nearly 55% of ether outside staking, and propose a way to move them to quantum-resistant security.

items.title: Cathie Wood Bets $91M on Anthropic IPO While Paring Crypto Exposure
items.body: The firm bought 934,968 Anthropic shares across six ETFs on the Claude maker’s Nasdaq debut while trimming a combined $4.1 million from its Ethereum and Solana staking ETFs.

items.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
items.body: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.

items.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
items.body: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.
